scope: Implementation-relevant differences in the two retrieved versions; publication prose and reference changes excluded. PDF pages 3-4 visually inspected.

differences.our_code: v3: one LayerNorm before attention, none before FFN
differences.effect: Substantive architecture difference; changes scale handling and gradient dynamics. Cause of reproduction gap remains untested.

differences.v1: No explicit distribution specified for URformer initial channel in architecture section
differences.v3: Explicit random complex Gaussian matrix, zero mean, normalized variance
differences.our_code: Paper-setting reproduction uses CN(0,1), redrawn during training; matched-supervision study instead intentionally shares spectral initialization with our model
differences.effect: v3 adds a reproducible direction, but exact meaning of normalized variance and redraw policy remain unspecified.

differences.v1: Small MLP on K (kappa); depth and output range not stated in that paragraph
differences.v3: Elementwise compact two-layer MLP mapping a scalar kappa into (0,1)
differences.effect: Two-layer form and bounded output follow v3; hidden width32 and ReLU remain implementation assumptions.

differences.v1: Gate alpha(t)=sigmoid(g(t)); FilterNet_psi and Former_phi without stage superscripts
differences.v3: FilterNet_psi(t-1), Former_phi(t-1), alpha(t-1)=sigmoid(g(t-1)); following prose still says g(t)
differences.our_code: Ten separate layers, each with its own filter, gate and Transformer
differences.effect: Index renaming does not change calculation when stages are consistent. v3 makes stage dependence clearer; weight sharing policy in authors code should be confirmed.

differences.v1: Table gives20,000 examples but not batch size or initial learning rate; inspected HTML does not specify Adam/cosine/50epochs
differences.v3: Adam, cosine annealing Tmax50, batch32, initial learning rate0.001
differences.our_code: Follows v3; Adam defaults and clipping1 remain assumptions
differences.effect: v3 supplies training settings missing in v1.

differences.v1: All proportionality constants normalized to unity; Z=|HS+B+W|
differences.v3: Explicit known atomic gain G multiplying magnitudes and used in the objective; specifies Cs transition and37.406GHz
differences.our_code: Known G is divided out; estimation uses G=1
differences.effect: Equivalent normalized measurements if G is known and noise is treated in the pre-magnitude field domain. No M-dependent SNR shift follows.

differences.v1: Eq1 defines tilde(h); adjacent prose mentions large-scale beta_k but no mapping from tilde(h) to h or beta value appears
differences.v3: Retains tilde(h) in Eq1 but drops the beta_k sentence
differences.our_code: Uses the displayed sum directly as h, unit-variance complex path gains
differences.effect: Neither version completely specifies channel gain/normalization law; no undocumented normalization is inferred.

differences.v3: P omitted from TableI but Fig3 discussion explicitly setsP20
differences.our_code: P20training and Fig3; Fig4 uses same model for pilot-transfer diagnostics
differences.effect: No Fig3 change. Separate training by pilot count remains unspecified.

differences.v3: Corrected to -20 dB at P=15; agrees with approximate plotted -20.2 dB
differences.our_code: Audit uses plotted values, not the obsolete v1 prose claim
differences.effect: Changes the reproduction target; this is a reporting correction, not an architecture change.

Magnitude field model with complex Gaussian noise before magnitude
Stated SNR and RSR ratios; no explicit extra factorM
Direct phase reconstruction, kappa=2Z|Y|/sigma2, convex gated filtering and pilot pseudoinverse
Three encoders, width64; attention uses LayerNorm then residual
Final complex residual added to linear channel estimate
Mean per-example linear NMSE training loss
unresolved_in_both: Joint subray angular distribution and angular spread
Path gain variance, possible normalization between tilde(h) and h
Pilot alphabet, power and refresh policy
Training SNR distribution or separate models per SNR/P
Attention head count, FFN widths/activations, output FFN details, dropout
